entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I'm calling to see about returning a recent purchase.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I bought a VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor a couple of weeks ago and I'd like to return it if possible.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number?
Of course. My name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF-774901.

Thank you, Sam. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 26th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it works perfectly fine. Honestly, it was a bit of an impulse buy. I've just changed my mind about needing it. I thought I would use it for training, but I just don't use it.
I see. Thanks for clarifying. Let me just review the return eligibility for you.
Okay. I was a bit concerned I was outside the window and would have to find a resale marketplace or something. I'm hoping we can work something out, maybe even a partial credit?
No need for that, Sam. I've just checked our policy, and it looks like you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return period. I can cannot offer a refund for you right now.
Oh! Ninety days? I thought it would be much shorter. That's fantastic, thank you. I was all prepared to negotiate.

It's no problem at all. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
That's perfect. Simple enough. Thank you for making that so easy, Diana.
You're very welcome, Sam. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see the refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
